content: Importance of construction project management, Project life cycle,
Stages in Construction, Causes of project failure, Organization types
with its advantages and disadvantages
Introduction of contract and its importance, Criteria for a valid
contract, Types of contracts with its advantages and disadvantages,
Disputes in the contract and its preventive measures
Introduction of project planning, Project Planning-methods and
factors affecting planning, Basic network analysis methods: CPM &
PERT, Critical Path Method - Important terms, Basic, network
rules, Basic examples of CPM network, PERT analysis: Optimistic
time, Most likely time and pessimistic time of a project, Basic
examples on PERT method, Cost optimization in the project, Recent
trends for construction project planning and management
Resource management introduction and its purpose, Material
management: Introduction, ABC analysis for material classification,
material procurement through an online platform, and storage &
safety of material, Manpower management: Introduction about
Ministry of labour and employment, acts for labour such as Trade
union act, Minimum Wage act, Contract labour act, child labour act
etc. and safety of labours at construction site, Basics of Equipment
management, Basics of project finance management, Safety
management: Causes of accidents on site and its preventive
measures at construction site, Project Management Information
System (PMIS) concept
Total Hours 42
